⚡ Bolt: Prevent unnecessary React re-renders in RulesPanel
* 💡 What: Used `isDeepEqual` from `utils/performance.js` inside `setRules`.
* 🎯 Why: To avoid unnecessarily updating state and triggering Virtual DOM diffing during data fetches when the rules haven't actually changed.
* 📊 Impact: Prevents unnecessary cascading re-renders when data structures haven't changed.
* 🔬 Measurement: Observe reduced Virtual DOM diffing overhead when `RulesPanel` components fetch data that is identical to current state.
